title: Why Japan had NO Chance in WW2
summary: Military History Visualized charts ship production by the United States and Japan from December 1941 to September 1945. The growing numbers show why Japan, despite a stronger starting navy, could not win a long war.
why: Cited as one of the best visualizations of how overwhelmingly dominant US industrial output was in the Pacific war.

quote.text: One of the best visualizations I've come across of just how dominant the US industrial base was in the 1940s under full mobilization.
